title: [spec-gap][R-07-045] Application chunking (POST /firmware/upload {chunk,total,data}, 1281-byte fit MUST) absent in all stacks
description: spec/07-transport-app.md:765-781: 'For payloads exceeding the receiver's known reassembly limit, use application-level chunking. If the limit is unknown, chunks MUST fit the mandatory 1281-byte SCHC receiver capacity' with the POST /firmware/upload {chunk: N, total: M, data} pattern (2.04 per chunk, 2.01 + hash on complete). NO implementation anywhere: rg firmware/upload|/firmware across rust/, python/src, lichen/ = no CoAP resource, no {chunk,total,data} codec, no firmware vectors (no test/vectors/*firmware*). The 1281 fit rule is enforced only inside SCHC reassembly (rust reassembly_state_machine.rs:179-186 receiver_capacity_bounds_are_enforced_during_reassembly; py MAX_SCHC_PACKET=1281 fragment.py:40-41 + reassembly.py:45-53; C SCHC_FRAGMENT_DEFAULT_RECEIVER_LIMIT 1281u schc.h:132) - no application chunker exists to consult or default to it. Suggested placement: CoAP resource /firmware/upload in each stack's CoAP server (py resources/, rust lichen-node resources, C coap subsystem), chunk size = min(known peer limit, 1281); negative vector: chunk >1281 rejected when peer limit unknown. Depends on the same peer-capability plumbing as OTA/SMP work (lora-ipv6-mesh-o9l update-state epic).
